CREATE TABLE memory_vector_work (
	generation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	desired_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	applied_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_change INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	due_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	claim_token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	last_code VARCHAR(80), 
	preparation_key VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (generation, item_id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_memory_vector_work_world_id ON memory_vector_work (world_id)

CREATE TABLE memory_vector_changes (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, 
	root_sequence INTEGER, 
	source_kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	cursor VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_memory_vector_change_frontier UNIQUE (root_sequence, source_kind, source_key)
)

)

CREATE TABLE memory_vector_dependencies (

	source_kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id, source_kind, source_key)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_memory_vector_dependency_source ON memory_vector_dependencies (source_kind, source_key, item_id)

CREATE TABLE memory_vector_maintenance (
	generation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	cursor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	upper_bound VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	cutoff INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	due_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (generation)
)

CREATE TABLE memory_vector_attempts (
	item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	profile VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	credential_revision VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(24), 
	retry_after FLOAT NOT NULL,
